truthBoundary.cp08Decomposition: immutable evidence only; never native or proof coverage

truthBoundary.advisoryManual: retained until a separate bounded packet proves a native replacement

componentPolicy.nativePacketOwnership: one native-predicate per skill; CP09 limit 5, CP12 limit 1
componentPolicy.retentionPacketOwnership: one advisory and one manual per skill in CP11 batches of 10
componentPolicy.externalStatus: blocked and not routed to product implementation

packetDerivation.algorithm: sort skillIds by family then catalogId; chunk native by family nativeBatchLimit and retention by 10
